verdict.rationale: Claude is operated by natural-language prompting. The docs list chat on web, desktop and mobile, direct model prompting through the Messages API, and NL-driven agent actions: searching the web, creating files, running code, and handing off or scheduling tasks. Computer-use and bash tools let plain-language requests drive desktop and shell actions. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation framing natural-language commands as a way to operate the product's own surfaces (admin and console management is documented only as a programmatic Admin API), and independent hands-on corroboration specific to NL command operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
